verdict.rationale: Grafana Cloud names its own AI capabilities, Grafana Assistant and Investigations, and natural-language understanding of production systems. The knowledge graph also continuously generates insights highlighting errors, anomalies and failures. However, no evidence describes the AI taking an alert or error, investigating it, and proposing a probable root cause. missing for 10: documentation of AI-driven alert/error investigation workflow, explicit root-cause hypothesis output, linkage from a firing alert to the AI investigation, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can have the platform's AI investigate an alert or error and propose a probable root cause

citations.quote: Includes AI-powered capabilities for engineering teams, including Grafana Assistant, Investigations, Agent Observability, and more.
Understand production systems faster using natural language
It continuously generates insights that highlight saturation, errors, anomalies, failures, and configuration changes
